description: Source code for the 'oseama' utility, which handles reading, creating, and extracting entities within a Seama container format. It includes functions for parsing options, reading headers, computing MD5 checksums, and managing entity data.

methods.name: oseama_info
methods.description: Displays information about a Seama file, including metadata entries and entity details.

methods.name: oseama_entity
methods.description: Creates or appends entities to a Seama file, including handling metadata and padding.

methods.name: oseama_extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific entity from a Seama container to an output file.
